content.text:
A mule (donkey sire x horse mare), a real hybrid animal. Horse-sized body with deep chest, long back, long neck and horse proportions, with the donkey's long ears, short thick head, short upright mane, thin legs, small hooves and tufted tail; plain coat, no stripes or spots. Head fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Bilaterally symmetrical, with recognizable limbs and visible sense organs. Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.

summary.text:
**Composing mule portrait details**
I'm planning a single mule with a horse-sized body, deep chest, long neck and back, plus donkey traits like long ears, short thick head, upright mane, thin legs, small hooves, and tufted tail, in natural light with clear eyes and soft shadow.
**Composing natural history illustration**
I'm planning a realistic natural history illustration of a mule in side three-quarter view, with a plain light background, watercolor style, and clear details of the head, ears, mane, and coat in a 1:1 format.
**Refining mule proportions**
I'm preparing another generation to adjust the body toward horse-like proportions, with a longer back and neck and a larger, more horse-sized build.
